rationale.s2.l2.app-session: Primary factual predecessor: composition, credential/generation ownership, admission and draft handoff, stream/canonical recovery, requests/terminals, settings/Skills, rendering and maintenance limits. L3 relates those accepted local mechanisms into user journeys; it does not enlarge the family audit.
rationale.s2.l2.desktop-web: Actual cross-unit evidence for Electron-main readiness before renderer publication, host/preload trust boundaries, stored-remote fallback, stable-exit restart discrepancy, and native SQLite draft persistence. These facts are used in entry and draft journeys, not merely linked for navigation.
rationale.s2.l2.design-tui: Actual cross-unit evidence for shared UI caller/dialog lifetimes, locale versus layout direction, segmented-control direction limit, browser-theme preview ownership, and generated-output boundaries. No TUI runtime or pending L3 account is used as evidence.
rationale.s2.l1.app-session: Directly consumes Assets, localization and verification evidence for exact existing test paths/assertion scopes and performance-test exclusion. Those source-backed observations provide proposed verification routes; no product test was run.
rationale.s2.l3.desktop-web: Optional next consultation for the separate desktop/host journey. Its eventual body is not a factual input, accepted predecessor or build edge here.
rationale.s2.l3.design-tui: Optional next consultation for the separate TUI/shared-design journey. Its eventual body is not a factual input, accepted predecessor or build edge here.
